title: docs(adr): ADR-0070 Accepted — P1–P3 implemented, merged & live-verified
body:
Marks **ADR-0070 (Package-first authoring)** as **Accepted** now that P1–P3 are implemented, merged, and verified end-to-end.

- **Status**: Proposed → Accepted.
- Adds an **Implementation status** section: P1 kernel ([framework#2285](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/framework/pull/2285)), P2 Studio ([objectui#1970](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/pull/1970)), P3 AI ([cloud#479](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/pull/479) + [cloud#481](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/pull/481); tests [cloud#480](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/cloud/pull/480)).
- Records the **live dogfood** result: a one-sentence magic build + iterative business-user changes (add related object, add field) all landed in **one** app base (`app.iojn`) — live, editable, no `com.workspace`, no orphans.
- Annotates the **Rollout** (D1–D3 ✅; D4 lifecycle / D5 migration / D6 framing ⏳).

Docs-only; no code or changeset.
